_readme: Real products, prices and URLs pulled from www.elderfrost.com/shop. Edit 'note' freely. 'url' points at your live Squarespace product page. 'sold_out' hides the buy CTA and shows a waitlist badge. 'from' renders the price as 'from $X'.
page_title: Elderfrost Nursery — Jerusalem artichokes for Zone 5
tagline: Jerusalem artichokes and the cold-hardy perennials that grow beside them — grown and tested in Zone 5.

products.name: Jerusalem Artichoke Tubers
products.subtitle: 8 oz · 1 lb · 3 lb
products.note: Shipped in damp sawdust to keep them that way. 8 oz $18 · 1 lb $27 · 3 lb $50. Our 2025 crop came through a Northeast drought, so the tubers run small — more tubers per pound, and no need to cut them apart.

products.name: Walking Onion Bulbs
products.subtitle: Perennial live plants
products.note: Potent onion greens from a patch that plants itself. These bulbs are already rooting, so they put on more size this year than top-set bulbs planted in late summer.

products.name: Big Top Western Horseradish
products.subtitle: Roots and plants
products.note: Same hardiness, same vigor, same indifference to bad soil as the sunchokes. Dig it every fall or it'll do exactly what the sunchokes do.

products.name: Myoga Ginger
products.subtitle: Cold-hardy young plants, Zone 5b
products.note: Japanese ginger that survives our winters. The flower buds and young shoots are the crop, and potted plants establish about half a season ahead of root divisions.

products.name: Native New England Thornless Raspberry
products.subtitle: Plants and cuttings
products.note: Native, thornless American wild raspberry. Came through 80° days, nights in the upper 30s and three inches of rain in a day — still standing.

products.name: Allegheny Blackberry
products.subtitle: High bush, native species
products.note: A native blackberry that makes a real hedge — pollinator plant, bird plant and berry crop in one bush. Our biggest stock item.

products.name: Ebony King Blackberry
products.subtitle: Erect canes, high yields
products.note: Erect canes, so less trellising than most blackberries, and it yields hard. Only six in stock.

products.name: Native New England Swamp Dewberry
products.subtitle: Bristly dewberry, running swamp blackberry
products.note: A moisture-loving native bramble that grows where the ground stays wet — exactly where sunchokes would rot.

products.name: Honeyberry Haskap — Borealis
products.subtitle: Live cuttings
products.note: Flowers early, sets fruit in Zone 2, tastes like a blueberry-raspberry cross. Plant two varieties for pollination.

products.name: Willoughby Black Currant
products.subtitle: Plants or cuttings
products.note: Hardy berry shrub, and one this climate should be growing far more of. Cuttings root easily, which is why we can sell them this way.

products.name: Scotia Elderberry
products.subtitle: Live plant cuttings
products.note: Cold-hardy and high-yield. Wants a partner variety nearby for a good fruit set, and the same damp-ish feet the dewberry likes.

products.name: Hybrid Willow
products.subtitle: Plants and cuttings
products.note: Privacy screen, erosion control, biomass, basketry — and the windbreak that protects everything else here. Same rough ground as the sunchokes.
